title: Compliance Acknowledgment
description: Confirm you have read the required policy material and describe how it applies to your role.
instructions:
After reviewing the assigned policy material:

  1. Write a brief statement (150–300 words) confirming you have read and understood the material.
  2. Describe two specific situations in your own role where this policy applies, and what you would do in each.
  3. Note any part of the policy that is unclear to you — questions are encouraged and do not affect your result.

Your submission is recorded with a timestamp as evidence of completion.
grading_guidelines:
This is a pass/fail acknowledgment. A passing submission:

  • Confirms the material was reviewed
  • Gives two genuine, role-specific examples (not copied from the policy text)
